BL-1055 — A hydrate run has no end condition: when the specifier finishes draining and hands off to the coder, nothing stops the swarm, so the run either builds what hydrate promised not to build or idles until a human notices
What it solves: Source intake:
`.swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-mono-router-hydrate-lock-resident-on-specifier.md`
(operator via Cursor, 2026-07-28; archived on drain). Split 1:N with
BL-1054 - this ticket carries the intake's "What we need" item 3 and the
exit half of item 4.
Approval context: Nothing needs deciding; this is the stop condition BL-698 already pinned, made real on the pack. Flagged pending only because the feature file is new.
Worth knowing: with BL-1054's lock but without this, a finished hydrate run is SAFE but manual - the specifier hands off, the coder never wakes beca…
